project_type: Next.js 16 app router with Prisma 7 ORM, PostgreSQL via @prisma/adapter-pg (Neon)
build_system: npm with Next.js build, Prisma generate as postinstall
test_framework: No test framework configured - no test files exist in the project
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npx prisma generate` to validate schema. 2. Run `npm run build` to verify TypeScript compiles and Next.js builds successfully. 3. Manually verify API route file structure exists.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ - generated by `npx prisma generate` from prisma/schema.prisma. Must re-run after schema changes.
setup_instructions: 1. npm install 2. npx prisma generate (runs as postinstall) 3. Create .env with POSTGRES_URL 4. npx prisma migrate dev (if migrations exist) or npx prisma db push
environment_constraints: No database available in sandbox - cannot run migrations or seed. Build validation via `next build` is the primary verification. The app uses POSTGRES_URL env var. Prisma 7 requires PrismaPg adapter passed to PrismaClient constructor.
contribution_requirements: Never use createMany (SQLite/libsql compat). All API routes must have try/catch. Error messages must be in response body. UI must surface errors visibly. App must be accessible (ARIA, keyboard nav, semantic HTML).
key_patterns: 1. DB client: src/lib/db.ts exports `prisma` as lazy Proxy and `db.client` getter. 2. API routes: Next.js app router at src/app/api/*/route.ts with NextRequest/NextResponse, try/catch, error in JSON body. 3. Pages: 'use client' with useState/useEffect, fetch from API routes. 4. Prisma client import: from '@/generated/prisma/client'. 5. Tailwind CSS 4 with @import 'tailwindcss' in globals.css. 6. Components in src/components/. 7. Schema uses cuid() for IDs.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js app router pages and API routes. src/components/ - React components. src/lib/ - utility modules (db.ts). src/generated/prisma/ - Prisma generated client. prisma/ - schema.prisma. scripts/ - utility scripts. public/ - static assets.
